objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact containing company-wide regulations, processes, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions that undergoes creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code identifying the document type (e.g., RL, PA).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned to each document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or description of the document content.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle (e.g., In Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document becomes valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which the document is no longer valid.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person responsible for creating and signing the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional person with editing rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person who checks document for technical and formal aspects.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person who translates document content to another language.

attributes.name: reader_group
attributes.description: User group with read-only access to the document.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual text and information contained in the document.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The primary language version of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or related items.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Systems or applications referenced in the document.

attributes.name: validity_domain
attributes.description: Companies or areas where the document applies.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is automatically released with the main document and whose changes trigger a new version of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state matching the main document release process.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The file or document content of the attachment.

attributes.name: archive_status
attributes.description: Indication of whether the attachment is archived.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle and requiring no formal approval or checking.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The text or file content of the additional information.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published.

attributes.name: deletion_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information has been deleted.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with defined roles and authorizations in the document management system.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Group membership defining collective authorizations.

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: Scope of read and write permissions.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users with assigned collective read and change rights.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the user group.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Number of users in the group.

attributes.name: authorization_scope
attributes.description: Types of documents and actions the group can access.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggestion for modifying a released document without altering its content or version history until approved.

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: Author of the change proposal.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state indicating whether it is scheduled for implementation or completed.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Details of the proposed changes.

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Whether the proposal has been scheduled or implemented.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and confirm the continued validity of a document approaching its validity expiration date.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: The document for which validity extension is requested.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the extension request processing.

attributes.name: days_before_expiration
attributes.description: Number of days until document validity expires when request is created.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no continued validity.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: The document being invalidated.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the override processing.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: User who created the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: The document to be reactivated.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Member of Business Admin group creating the reactivation request.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the reactivation processing.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A collection of users or user groups designated to receive a document and any related notifications or acknowledgements.

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Groups assigned to receive the document.

attributes.name: person
attributes.description: Individual users assigned to receive the document.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Method of distribution (by email or for acknowledgement).

objs.name: archive
objs.description: Storage location for invalidated documents with restricted access for a defined period.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period of time documents remain archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: archive_group
attributes.description: User group with continued read access to archived documents.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user interface displaying role-specific documents and document-related information.

attributes.name: user_role
attributes.description: Type of user the dashboard is configured for.

attributes.name: document_list
attributes.description: Collection of documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A generated evaluation or search result of documents and instructions in the system.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Category of report (Status Report, Search Report, etc.).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Criteria used to filter report results.

attributes.name: role_specific
attributes.description: Whether the report is tailored to a specific user role.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process for managing document approval, distribution and status transitions with defined participant steps.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: A distinct phase in the workflow such as Creator, Review, or Release.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User assigned to complete a workflow step.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow (In Progress, Completed, Rejected).

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature documenting workflow step completion.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document format that can be selected when creating new documents of a specific type.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document this template applies to.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Base format of the template (MS Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: tag_technology
attributes.description: Integrated mechanism for automatically printing metadata in documents.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate creation of a new document with selection of document type and template.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify the content or properties of a document.

evts.name: upload_content
evts.description: Attach external files or generate documents based on standard Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Define and update standardized and customer-specific attributes and properties.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert document from source format to PDF for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read and change rights to users and user groups for a document.

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: Start the three-step workflow process for document approval.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically sign a document during a workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content for technical and formal aspects in the workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document making it visible to designated readers.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Automatically generate a new version of a document when specified changes occur.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw authorization for an invalidated document while retaining data.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a suggestion for amending a document without affecting current version.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Incorporate an approved change proposal resulting in a new document version.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Review and confirm continued validity of a document approaching expiration.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document invalid and remove it from circulation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Send document to designated users or user groups via email notification.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Require designated document recipients to actively confirm receipt and understanding.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Document recipients verify and confirm their acknowledgement of a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Convert a released document's content into another language.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Review and release a translated document version via workflow.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Create role-specific evaluation or search results for documents in the system.

evts.name: access_dashboard
evts.description: View role-specific document list and related information.

evts.name: attach_additional_information
evts.description: Add a non-controlled supplement to a document.

evts.name: attach_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document that is released with the main document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Remove non-controlled supplementary information from a document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived to be removed upon next version release.

o2o.description: A document can reference or link to another document.
A document can have multiple attachments that are released with it.
A document can have additional information supplements.
A change proposal is created for and linked to a specific document.
A document is assigned a distribution list for email and acknowledgement distribution.
A document is created from or based on a template of the corresponding document type.
A document has assigned author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser user roles.
A user is a member of one or more user groups.
A validity extension request is linked to the document being reviewed.
An override request is linked to the document being invalidated.
A reactivation request references the document to be restored.

Document release workflow is started in this event.
Document is reviewed by assigned reviewers in this event.
Document is approved and published in this event.
New version of document is created in this event.
Document is invalidated and archived in this event.
Document validity period is extended in this event.
Document is invalidated in this event.
Document is restored from archive in this event.
Document is sent to recipients in this event.
Document is translated to another language in this event.
User initiates document creation.
User modifies document content or properties.
User is granted read or write permissions on a document.
User electronically signs during workflow step.

User confirms receipt and understanding of a document.
User reviews and releases translated document.
